allow: Bash(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\('found:', d['found'], '| path:', d['path'], '| cost: $', d['totalCost']\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"source":"LHR","destination":"BLR","optimizeBy":"cheapest"}'; $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/shortest-path" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json"; "cheapest: $\($resp.path -join ' -> '\) | Cost:`$$\($resp.totalCost\) | Rating:$\($resp.avgRating\)"; $body2 = '{"source":"LHR","destination":"BLR","optimizeBy":"smart"}'; $resp2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/shortest-path" -Method POST -Body $body2 -ContentType "application/json"; "smart: $\($resp2.path -join ' -> '\) | Cost:`$$\($resp2.totalCost\) | Rating:$\($resp2.avgRating\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"source":"LHR","destination":"BLR"}'; $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/compare" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json"; $modes = @\('cheapest','fastest','smart','min_layover'\); foreach \($m in $modes\) { $r = $resp.comparison.$m; "$m : $\($r.path -join '->'\) | Cost:`$$\($r.totalCost\) | Time:$\($r.totalTime\)min | Rating:$\($r.avgRating\) | Stops:$\($r.stops\)" })
